title: Readying the Ritual
description: In the throne room. Emperor Palpatine tells Rey to ignite her lightsaber and approach him. It is time for her to dispatch the emperor. In doing so she will free him from his current mortal form and finally accomplish the Sith goal of ending the Jedi. Rey ignites her blade and rears back to make the strike... Or so it would seem. When her hand reappears, her weapon is gone.
